description: Comprehensive stable finding code catalog mapping every diagnostic across specload.py, speccheck.py, peripheral.py, topology.py, records.py, specmd.py, prosefacts.py, resolve.py, docresolve.py, index.py, corpus.py, worklist.py, inventory.py, drift.py, stubgen.py, textcheck.py, headingcheck.py, review.py, attribution.py, and spec.py, plus the 31 BF-* regression codes and AUTO-5 warning codes.

codes.pattern: (expected .* but got|mapping values are not allowed here|while scanning|while parsing|found unexpected|could not find expected)
codes.description: YAML syntax or scanner/parser error in strict loader

codes.pattern: (YAML directive .* is refused|directives are not allowed)
codes.description: YAML %YAML or %TAG directive refused (D6)
Duplicate key in YAML mapping
YAML &anchor or *alias refused (D6)
Explicit YAML tag refused (D6)
YAML << merge key refused (D6)

codes.pattern: (mapping key .* is not a string|non-string key)
codes.description: Non-string mapping key refused
Floating-point scalar refused

codes.pattern: (was read as a boolean|was read as an integer|sexagesimal|octal)
codes.description: Unquoted YAML 1.1 boolean/integer/octal/sexagesimal ambiguity (D6)
Refused control character, UTF-8 BOM, or bidirectional formatting character
Required JSON Schema property missing
Value not in JSON Schema enum

codes.pattern: (does not match|is not of type|was read as .* expected|is too short|is too long|Additional properties are not allowed)
codes.description: JSON Schema pattern, type, or length constraint failed
Unevaluated or additional property rejected by schema
Invalid or out-of-root source-observed schema extension fragment

codes.pattern: (a \*\.facts\.yaml file holds kind: facts|kind: facts belongs in a \*\.facts\.yaml file)
codes.description: File suffix (.facts.yaml vs .spec.yaml) disagrees with kind: facts
Finding inside a --context-root downgraded to warning

codes.pattern: (^not read as a spec:|is not read: specs are|is not read: the extension is|backup file .* is not read)
codes.description: Misnamed spec file (.spec.yml, .spec.md, backup) or .facts.yaml placed inside a spec root

codes.pattern: (root .* is not trusted|in an untrusted root)
codes.description: Fail-closed rejection of citations into an untrusted root

codes.pattern: spec id .* is also declared by
codes.description: Duplicate non-overlay spec id across roots

codes.pattern: (alias .* is the id of another spec|spec id .* is also an alias in)
codes.description: Spec alias collides with another spec id or alias

codes.pattern: fact id .* is (used twice in this file|also used by)
codes.description: Duplicate fact, instance, or variant id within a spec id and root
Duplicate resource entry name in a spec file

codes.pattern: document .* is not in this file's resources\.documents
codes.description: Citation names a document absent from resources.documents
Citation names a map-only document with cite: false
Support entry class disagrees with cited document class
Page locator has leading zeros

codes.pattern: is outside the .* pages of document
codes.description: Cited page number exceeds document page count
Page range [first, last] runs backwards

codes.pattern: is paged, so a standard locator needs a section, page, pages, table, figure or clause, not a heading alone
codes.description: Paged standard cited by heading alone

codes.pattern: (names repos entry .*, which is not in this file's resources\.repos|series target .* names no repos entry)
codes.description: Anchor, notice, or series target names an undeclared repos entry

codes.pattern: pins a ref, not a commit
codes.description: Cited repos entry pins a ref rather than an immutable commit hash

codes.pattern: is not in the files of repos entry .* \(the closed list of cited paths, D12\)
codes.description: Anchor path is absent from the closed repos[].files list (D12)
Source anchor line range [start, end] runs backwards

codes.pattern: assumption .* is not in this file's assumptions
codes.description: Fact cites an assumption absent from the file

codes.pattern: access: private under a public root
codes.description: Private document or corpus entry under a public root

codes.pattern: is not a public skill \(pass --public-skill NAME if it is\)
codes.description: Tool via: skill:<name> is not declared as a public skill under a public root

codes.pattern: (is not accepted by root .* \(license gate, D13\)|has no license)
codes.description: Direct or transitive source license rejected by the root accepts list (D13)
Fact reference (#id, spec#id, spec@root#id) does not resolve

codes.pattern: already does in this premise list
codes.description: Duplicate fact reference in an inference premise list

Peripheral spec is not attached to any instance or board parts

codes.pattern: (overlays .* resolves to no spec|is not a section of the target|the target .* is of kind .*, which has no instances)
codes.description: Overlay target is missing or incompatible with overlay sections/instances

codes.pattern: overlays of .* in root .*; their merge order is undefined
codes.description: Multiple overlays target the same spec in one root

codes.description: Fact carries a current FAIL verification verdict

codes.pattern: its current verdict in .* is ADJUDICATE
codes.description: Fact carries a current ADJUDICATE verification verdict

codes.pattern: has no second reader in readers
codes.description: Critical fact verdict lacks a second independent reader

codes.description: GAP verdict recorded for a fact that has support

codes.pattern: verdict key .* names no fact, instance or variant of

codes.description: Source anchor file, line range, or symbol failed resolution at pinned commit

codes.pattern: claim hex values not bound to a cited line sharing an identifier with their sentence
codes.description: Claim hex literal appears in the cited lines, but no line of a single citation (nor its nearest preceding '{' line or the anchor symbol) shares an identifier token with the claim sentence holding it; an error under --strict-claims

codes.pattern: claim identifier range .*: end identifier .* absent from cited text
codes.description: End identifier of a claim range PREFIX<n><suffix>..PREFIX<m><suffix> absent from the fact's cited text

codes.pattern: claim identifier range .*: successor .* present in cited text
codes.description: PREFIX<m+1> present in the fact's cited text, so the claim range ends early; suppressed when another range in the claim starts there

codes.pattern: claim ngpios = <.*> absent from cited text
codes.description: Claim 'ngpios = <N>' does not appear in the fact's cited text
Local document bytes SHA-256 differs from resources.documents[].sha256

PDF has no outline bookmarks or document has no headings to index
Document index file sha256 or page count differs from resources.documents

codes.description: Checked root is missing corpus.yaml (#153)

codes.pattern: corpus\.yaml.* (is not listed|does not match|resolves to nothing|is listed twice)
codes.description: Corpus ledger disposition, document coverage, or sha256 mismatch
Hardware TODO entry omits verification method
